div.h1: Odoo Business Show: Rwanda's Largest Enterprise Tech Event

img.alt: GlobX team member engaging with an attendee at Odoo Business Show 2026

div.p: Kigali hosted nearly 1,000 attendees from across the business and technology ecosystem at the Radisson Blu Hotel & Convention Centre for the Odoo Business Show, Rwanda's largest enterprise technology event to date. Business leaders, policymakers, entrepreneurs, technologists, and students gathered to explore the growing demand for digital business management solutions and witness how integrated platforms like Odoo can streamline operations, reduce costs, and support organisational growth. Live demonstrations highlighted that ERP systems are no longer exclusive to large corporations; small and medium businesses, as well as individual entrepreneurs, can now leverage automation and digitisation to improve efficiency and control.

GlobX emphasised that Odoo adoption goes beyond digitising workflows. By connecting financial processes directly with operational activities, businesses gain real-time visibility, improve decision-making, and enhance transparency. The platform's adaptability across industries such as retail, manufacturing, finance, logistics, and professional services reinforced its position as a scalable, future-ready solution for Rwanda's rapidly modernising business landscape.
